from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3]
    if not horizontal_rows:
        return out
    last_bar = max(horizontal_rows)
    marker_cols = {c for r in range(last_bar + 1, height) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != 0}
    for c in marker_cols:
        previous = -1
        for r in horizontal_rows:
            if r > last_bar or c == 0 or c == width - 1:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c - 1]
            if color != 0 and color == grid[r][c + 1] and grid[r][c] == 0:
                for rr in range(previous + 1, r + 1):
                    out[rr][c] = color
                previous = r
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-312a6cb3.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
